title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → Person
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Person Identification/Name. Primary identity table. PIDM (internal key), ID (visible), names. Supports name history via SPRIDEN_CHANGE_IND.
Person Biographical. Birth date, gender, ethnicity flags, marital status, citizenship, religion, veteran status, deceased info.
Race code validation table. Defines valid race codes per federal reporting categories.
Person race. Multi-valued: one row per race selection per person. Links PIDM to GORRACE codes.
Email addresses. Multiple email types per person (institutional, personal, business) with preferred flag.
Person address. Multiple address types (permanent, mailing, campus, billing) with effective dates.
Person telephone. Multiple phone types (cell, home, business) with primary flag.
Additional identification. Alternate IDs (SSN, prior IDs, external IDs) by type.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Internal master key across all Banner tables. Never displayed to end users.
Direct map. Preferred first name field added in Banner 9.x. Null on older versions.

attribute_mappings.source: SPRIDEN (rows where SPRIDEN_CHANGE_IND IS NOT NULL)
attribute_mappings.transformation: Previous name records. SPRIDEN_CHANGE_IND = 'I' (ID change) or 'N' (name change). Historical rows provide name change audit trail.
Map: 'M'→'male', 'F'→'female'. Banner 9.x added SPBPERS_GNDR_CODE for expanded gender identity.
Map Banner gender identity codes to helix/gender-identity. Only in Banner 9.x and later.
Direct map. Pronoun support added in recent Banner versions.
Multi-valued: one GORPRAC row per selected race. Map GORPRAC_RACE_CDE via GORRACE to helix/ethnicity. Hispanic/Latino: check SPBPERS.SPBPERS_ETHN_CDE = '2' → 'hispanic_latino'.
Resolve citizenship code to nation code, then to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Map SPRADDR_STREET_LINE1-3, SPRADDR_CITY, SPRADDR_STAT_CODE, SPRADDR_ZIP, SPRADDR_NATN_CODE. SPRADDR_ATYP_CODE: 'PR'→'permanent', 'MA'→'mailing', 'CM'→'campus', 'BI'→'billing'. Use current effective-dated record per type.

attribute_mappings.source: SPBPERS.SPBPERS_VETC_FILE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL or SGBSTDN.SGBSTDN_VETC_CODE
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Banner veteran codes to helix/veteran-status. STVVETC defines valid codes.
